cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Seznámení posluchačů s podrobnou klasifikací půd ČR a také s mezinárodně používanou klasifikací FAO. Dále jsou ve výuce zahrnuty metody průzkumu a výzkumu půd a poznatky o informačním systému půd ČR. V rámci problematiky ochrany zemědělského půdního fondu jsou posluchači seznamováni jak se souborem legislativy, tak s možnostmi asanace a zlepšování degradovaných a devastovaných půd. Cílem je také seznámit posluchače s novými poznatky o vývoji zemědělského půdního fondu a jeho restrukturalizaci zvláště v souvislosti se vstupem České republiky do EU.

en.content: Soil Science F or Soil Science or Soil Science 2

The course "Soil Classification and Conservation" connects directly to the course "Soil Science" with a quantitatively new superstructure. This course includes extent and complete knowledge of soil classification in Czech republic and international soil classification FAO. The course deals with methods of soil exploration and soil research, soil monitoring of Czech republic, which observes changes in soil parameters developed by nature and anthropogenic factors. Important part of this course is also soil information systems. Also focused upon are findings of degradation and devastation of agriculture soil resources, and possibilities of improving and sanitising sick soil from the view conserving agricultural soil. The context includes information about principles of soil ethics and man management with the soil. Included is a total summary of soil resources in Czech republic and its legislative protection. Also presented are new findings regarding development in agricultural soil resources, evaluating its product potential, and soil valuation, especially in connection with admission of Czech republic to EU. en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The study aim is to introduce students to detailed soil classification of Czech republic, and the internationaly used soil classification FAO. Included in the course are Methods of soil exploration and soil research, and finding out about soil information system of Czech republic. Students are introduced to problems regarding conserving agricultural soil resources. Options regarding soil sanitation, and improving degraded and devastated soil. The next point of this course is to introduce the students to new findings in the development of agricultural soil resources and its transformation, especially in connection with admission of Czech republic to EU.
